title: Revolutionizing Film Creation! ByteDance's Star Model Seedance 2.5 Officially Released, the 30-Second Single-Take Production Era Has Arrived

content_html:
Recently, the ByteDance Seed team officially launched the next-generation video creation model Seedance 2.5. As an audio-visual joint generation model that focuses on "one-shot filming," the new version has made breakthrough upgrades in three core dimensions: long narrative, multi-modal references, and post-editing, comprehensively empowering multiple industry scenarios such as film, advertising, education, and industry.

In terms of video length and narrative expression, Seedance 2.5 has achieved a qualitative leap. The single generation duration has been significantly increased from 15 seconds to 30 seconds, and it supports seamless extension over multiple rounds, allowing complex storylines to unfold coherently. To address the common industry pain point of "greasiness," the model has undergone deep optimization on materials, skin texture, lighting, and saturation, effectively reducing the plastic-like feel of traditional generated videos and delivering a more realistic cinematic quality.

For complex creative needs, Seedance 2.5 has upgraded its multi-modal reference capabilities. Users can now input up to 30 images, 10 video clips, and 10 audio segments as reference materials in a single session. Additionally, the introduction of white model references and lighting control functions allows for more realistic spatial structure, motion paths, and physical lighting, greatly enhancing the stability of group storytelling and multi-subject interaction.

Moreover, the model also performs outstandingly in editing and controllability. The platform supports precise content editing through time stamps, enabling creators to make targeted modifications to aspects such as visual perspective, camera movement rhythm, and physical effects rendering under green screen backgrounds, thereby significantly reducing the cost of repeated generation and post-production splicing.

Currently, Seedance 2.5 is gradually being launched on platforms such as Ji Meng AI and Dou Bao Professional Edition. API services will also be available on Huo Yan Fang Zha within a short period, continuously providing efficient AI video generation solutions for a wide range of creators and industry ecosystems.

content_html_zh:
近日，字节跳动Seed团队正式推出下一代视频创作模型Seedance 2.5。 作为主打“一次拍摄”的视听联生成模式，新版本在长篇叙事、多模态引用、后期剪辑三个核心维度上进行了突破性升级，全面赋能电影、广告、教育、工业等多个行业场景。

在视频长度和叙事表达上，Seedance 2.5实现了质的飞跃。 单生成时长从15秒大幅提升至30秒，并支持多轮无缝延伸，让复杂的故事情节连贯展开。 针对行业普遍存在的“油腻”痛点，模型在材质、肤质、光照、饱和度等方面进行了深度优化，有效降低了传统生成视频的塑料感，呈现更真实的影院画质。

针对复杂的创意需求，Seedance 2.5升级了多模态参考能力。 用户现在可以在单个会话中输入最多 30 张图像、10 个视频剪辑和 10 个音频片段作为参考材料。 此外，白色模型参考和灯光控制功能的引入使得空间结构、运动路径和物理照明更加真实，大大增强了群体讲故事和多主体互动的稳定性。

此外，该模型在编辑性和可控性方面也表现出色。 平台支持通过时间戳进行精准的内容编辑，使创作者能够在绿屏背景下对视觉视角、镜头运动节奏、物理效果渲染等方面进行针对性修改，从而大幅降低重复生成和后期拼接的成本。

目前，Seedance 2.5正在逐步在极萌AI、豆宝专业版等平台上线。 火眼坊查的API服务也将在短期内上线，持续为广大创作者和行业生态提供高效的AI视频生成解决方案。
